name: Suzumiya Haru** no Koukotsu
source:
This is a gang bang novel adventure game based on "The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya"

After school, an envelope appeared on his desk.
"Wanna have your way with these girls?"
Also included in the letter was a time, a place, and a picture of the girls in the SOS Brigade. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE048829.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一款以《凉宫春日的忧郁》为背景的黑帮小说冒险游戏。

放学后，他的桌子上出现了一个信封。
“想和这些女孩子为所欲为吗？”
信中还附有时间、地点以及SOS大队女孩们的照片。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE048829.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
